title: After 2 months of learning game dev from scratch, I just finished my first game — a neon cyberpunk shooter! 🎮💜
author: ZaDevLabs
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm a solo developer. 2 months ago I didn't know anything about game development. I started learning HTML5, JavaScript, and somehow ended up building a full game.

Today I finally finished my first project — Neon Cyber Shooter!

What is it?

\- Fast-paced 2D neon cyberpunk shooter

\- Boss fights with unique attack patterns

\- Global leaderboard (compete with others!)

\- Achievement system

\- Scrap/currency system

\- Built with HTML5 + JavaScript, packaged for Android using Capacitor

Some numbers:

\- Built solo in 2 months

\- All code written by me.

What I learned:

\- Game loops, collision detection, sprite animation

\- Ad mediation (this was the hardest part lol)

\- How to stay consistent even when I wanted to quit

What I need from you:

Honest feedback! Does the neon visual style work? Is the difficulty fair? Would you play this?

Also — I'm about to publish on Google Play Store. Any tips for a first-time indie dev?

Thanks for reading! 🙏
